name: Subtle glass background
kurz: The dark area behind the equipment plan has a very subtle gradient towards anthracite and a light glass sheen; the panels sit on it like frosted glass.

wuensche.name: Subtle glass background
wuensche.wortlaut: The dark area around and behind the chart is not flat black: give it a very subtle gradient towards anthracite and a slight glass-like sheen, so the surface has a little depth — kept so restrained that the coloured bars and group headings clearly stand out in front.
